messages:
sarah_sales: Quick thread — AcmeBank is asking for a POC to migrate off VendorX to Redwood. Primary asks: API compatibility (prompt/response parity), pricing delta at scale, and answers for their security questionnaire. Can we outline blockers?

devon_se: Which VendorX features are they actually using? streaming, function-calls, reranking?

sarah_sales: Chat streaming + tool-calling + embeddings for semsearch. They also rely on exact JSON fields in responses (choices[], message.role/message.content).

oliver_engineer: OK. Two immediate tech notes: VendorX includes a top-level `conversation_id` and emits partial choice objects in stream chunks. Redwood's chat API streams as SSE with `data: {chunk}` events. We can implement a compat shim that: 1) rewrites our SSE->chunk framing, 2) maps message.role -> role, and 3) synthesizes conversation_id via request id. Prototype exists.

anya_security: From the SQ side they flagged 3 items as blockers: data residency (EU-only requirement), KMS/HSM integration for key separation, and proof of SOC2 + recent pentest. We need to provide the SOC2 cert + network architecture diagram and our vulnerability disclosure policy.

mike_infra: Dedicated pool + VPC/private deploy covers residency and isolation. KMS integration is supported via customer KMS in Private; in Hosted we can offer TPM-backed keys for enterprise. Timeline: infra can stand up an EU-dedicated POC cluster within 5 business days after contract.

sarah_sales: Pricing ask: they quoted VendorX at ~ $14k/mo for 200M prompt+completion tokens. They want Redwood delta for same throughput and response SLAs. Give a rough ballpark we can commit to in presales.

devon_se: Rough cost analysis (ballpark): with batching/kv cache/8-bit quantized model we expect infra amortized ~$6–8k/mo for equivalent token volume on Dedicated; plus Redwood service/observability ~ $2k/mo. So safe presales number: $9–11k/mo. Caveat: exact depends on response length distribution and streaming vs non-streaming.

oliver_engineer: For parity tests we should run a diff harness: take 500 canonical prompts, run them against VendorX and Redwood with compat shim, normalize JSON, and compute token/response deltas + BLEU/ROUGE/semantic embedding distance. I can wire up a quick harness this week. Example command:

```
python tests/compat_diff.py --prompts tests/acme_prompts.json --vendor vendorx --redwood redwood://poc-acme
```

mike_infra: Also note: VendorX returns `detected_language` meta in the choice objects — they use it in routing. Our shim can add `detected_language` from our language detector at ingest. Small latency penalty (~10–30ms).

sarah_sales: Great. Can we get the SOC2 + pentest and a short doc explaining the compat shim approach for the legal and engineering contacts? CC: @anya_security.

anya_security: I'll attach SOC2 and the pen-test redacted report. For legal we need an answer on data egress clauses and whether logs include full prompts by default. Our standard: logs are redact-able per customer and can be disabled in Private. Will confirm exact wording for the contract.

rdw-ci-bot: POC env created: redwood-poc-acme-eu (dev env) — creds have been provisioned to the SE team. :white_check_mark:

devon_se: Proposal for next steps: 1) oliver drops compat harness + sample results (2 days). 2) infra stands up EU-dedicated POC (5 days). 3) security provides docs + answers (2 days). 4) presales sends provisional pricing and POC SOW. Can we kick off Tues 09:30 UTC?

sarah_sales: Tue 09:30 UTC works for the Acme technical kickoff. I'll send calendar invite and include their engineering + legal.

oliver_engineer: I'll post the initial harness output to the thread when ready. Plan: include a small script to translate streaming frames:

```
# shim snippet
for event in sse_stream:
  chunk = json.loads(event.data)
  emit_chunk({"partial_choice": chunk})
```

mike_infra: I'll prepare a one-pager on differences we expect (stream framing, function call signature, conversation id) and mitigation steps for their app.

sarah_sales: Awesome — thanks everyone. Removing blockers: data residency + KMS (infra ok), compat parity (oliver/harness), pricing (devon rough ballpark). Any last minute asks? :eyes:

anya_security: Please add the contact for Acme's security reviewer so I can share the redacted pentest.

sarah_sales: Acme contact: hannah.lee@acmebank.com. Adding to invite. :thumbsup:
